page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Margin notes in the right margin: "Ezech.34." beside the fourth line of the text, and "Mat.11." beside the second-to-last line of the text. Running head at the top, page number 87 at the top right. Catchword "pietatis" at the right below the last line, signature "F 4" at the bottom left.

main_text.p: potiùs ( vt vno verbo dicam ) deripiuntur de Ecclesiâ membra viuentia Domini, quæ prætiofo sanguine suo comparauit, impietate, iniustitia, & inhumanitate, addo etiâ imprudentia indignissima eorum qui velut columnæ Christianitatis dici & haberi volunt. Iam plus satis in fratres nostros iniqui fuimus, & grassantur in Ecclesia Dei pastores qui pascunt se ipsos,Ezech.34. adipem comedentes, lanam induentes, quod optimum est mactantes, gregem non pascentes, ouem Christi morbo affectam non confirmantes, ægrotam non curantes, confractam non obligantes, depulsam non reducentes, pereuntem non requirentes, sed vi dominantes in gregem Christi & per sæuitiam, adeo vt dispersæ sint oues Christi destitutæ pastore, & sint cibo omnibus bestiis agri, dispersæ, & fraudi, violentiæ, atque tyrannidi impotentissimorum hominum expositæ. Iam plus satis ruimus præcipites in perniciem nostram ; & quamuis cum animis nostris veritatis diuinæ & gratiæ in Ecclesia confcij,tamen delicias facimus in ignoratione, infirmitate, & aberratione nostra. Videamus igitur deinceps,si vis facienda est,(est autem)vt nobis ipsis vim sanƈtè faciamus,memores illius quod olim dicebat Christus,rapi à violentis re-Mat.11.gnum Dei:qui in carne cæci sumus, videamus in Spiritu;qui infirmi, confirmemur ; qui dormientes,excitemur;qui segnes, animemur ;qui frigentes aut etiâ tepidi, inardescamus ad illa pietatis

page.notes: The small handwritten "354" at the top right is handwriting and is left out. The small dashes in the margin beside the text are marks, not printed text, and are left out. The printed word "Mat.11." is copied as printed. The word "vim" in "vim sanƈtè faciamus" and the spelling "sanƈtè" is copied as printed, and the ligature-like "Ƈ" in "sanƈtè" follows the scan's "ct" form. Printing variants such as "Ecclesiâ", "etiâ", "præcipites" and "ruimus" are left as printed.
